title: VFB Workshop — NeuroFly 2026: Bridging connectomes and transcriptomics across the Drosophila CNS
description: Interactive workshop materials from Virtual Fly Brain (VFB) for NeuroFly 2026 (21st Biennial European Drosophila Neurobiology Conference, University of Cologne, Germany, 7-11 September 2026). Covers finding, bridging, visualising and analysing neurons across connectomic and transcriptomic datasets, shown three ways: Python, VFB Chat / the VFB MCP, and the 3D Circuit Browser.
